description:
Welcome to this inviting 3-bedroom, 2-bath single-story home located on a generous 0.38-acre lot in the established Magnolia Center neighborhood. Built in 1985, this single-family residence offers a flexible den/office that can easily serve as a fourth bedroom, expansive concrete RV parking with room for multiple RVs, a large backyard workshop, potential ADU opportunities, and a mature orchard with a variety of seasonal fruit trees. Additional features include an attached 2-car garage, an additional large bonus room, and a durable tile roof.

Ideally situated in Riverside’s desirable 92506 zip code, the home offers convenient access to parks, schools, shopping, dining, and entertainment at Riverside Plaza. Enjoy the charm of a well-established neighborhood with easy access to the 91, 60, and 215 freeways, as well as close proximity to Downtown Riverside, the University of California, Riverside, California Baptist University, and more.
